title: How static-first CMS publishing works

seo.title: How static-first CMS publishing works
seo.description: Learn how BlockForge keeps CMS editing flexible while rendering public pages as instant server-rendered Next.js HTML.

content.text: The CMS writes draft JSON. Publishing validates the graph and creates a published snapshot. Next.js reads that snapshot during build and emits static HTML, metadata, schema, sitemap, and robots.

excerpt: A practical look at editing content dynamically while serving visitors static Next.js pages.
author: BlockForge
